scheme_name: Forest And Climate Change Internship Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a student pursuing Graduation, Post‑Graduation or Research work at a recognized university/institute in India or abroad.
Preference is given to students pursuing MSc or PGDM from IIFM.
Applicants may apply only once during a financial year.
The Ministry may adjust eligibility criteria, limit the number of applicants, and decide the mode of screening based on the number of applications received.
benefits_summary: Interns receive a monthly stipend of ₹10,000 (prorated), an experience certificate upon successful completion, and access to workspace and internet facilities.
